alerts.title: Trail Ridge Road is Closed to Through Travel for the Season
alerts.description: Trail Ridge Road is closed on the east side of the park at Many Parks Curve and on the west side at Colorado River Trailhead. Trail Ridge Road is not designed as an all-season road. The road typically reopens to through travel during the last week of May, weather permitting. For the latest information on the status of Trail Ridge Road, call 970-586-1222.
